prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static List<String> patchConfig(Map<String,String> base, List<String[]> patches)
Behavior: Copy the base configuration, then apply patches in order. Each patch is (operation,key,value): set overwrites, unset removes even when absent and ignores value. Reject an empty key or unknown operation. Return sorted key=value strings without mutating base.
Visible example: base {mode=safe, zone=in} patched by unset zone then set mode=fast returns [mode=fast].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<String> patchConfig(Map<String,String>b,List<String[]>p){var m=new HashMap<>(b);if(m.containsKey(""))return null;for(var x:p){if(x.length!=3||x[1].isEmpty())return null;if(x[0].equals("set"))m.put(x[1],x[2]);else if(x[0].equals("unset"))m.remove(x[1]);else return null;}var o=new ArrayList<String>();m.forEach((k,v)->o.add(k+"="+v));Collections.sort(o);return o;}}
